description: List the wall patterns, wall styles, and floor patterns you can paint/place on this lot. Wall patterns and floor patterns are the textures you select for paint-wall and paint-floor. Wall styles (5 in total) are the structural variants for place-wall. Prerequisite: none — this is a read-only catalog query; no lot ownership or permissions are required. Effect: returns three typed lists (wall_patterns, wall_styles, floor_patterns) sourced directly from the live WorldWallProvider and WorldFloorProvider loaded at bot startup. Cost: free. Roof styles are NOT in this list — they are a bare integer enum in the engine with no label catalog; if you need to know the current roof state, call query-architecture. Prices are per-unit (per-segment for walls, per-tile for floors) — multiply by the number of segments/tiles you intend to place to estimate cost.
call_signatures: cf $CF list-architecture-styles                                                                         # returns wall_patterns, wall_styles (5), floor_patterns
common_mistakes: Roof styles are intentionally absent — VMArchitecture.RoofStyle has no label catalog. Use query-architecture to read the current roof state.
wall_patterns and wall_styles are separate lists: wall_patterns are textures (paint-wall); wall_styles are structural variants (place-wall).
Prices are per-unit, not per-lot: price_per_segment applies to each wall segment placed; price_per_tile applies to each floor tile painted.
perception_hints: No perception state needed — list-architecture-styles is a catalog query, not a VM-state read.
Use id values from wall_patterns when calling paint-wall --pattern <id>.
Use id values from wall_styles when calling place-wall --style <id>.
Use id values from floor_patterns when calling paint-floor --pattern <id>.
refuse_conditions: content providers not initialised → returns ok:false with 'list-architecture-styles: content providers not initialised'
